group.name: Install ONE edition / Instala UNA edicion

plugin.name: Current Windows / Proton - IL2CPP
plugin.description: For the current Windows game (tested 2.4.2), including Proton. Requires matching BepInEx 6 IL2CPP and the game's compatibility patches, installed separately. Choose this if the game has GameAssembly.dll in its root.

plugin.name: Older Windows / Native Linux - Mono (experimental)
plugin.description: For Mono game builds (tested Windows 2.1.3 and native Linux 2.4.2). Requires matching BepInEx 6 Mono installed separately. Choose this if KingdomTwoCrowns_Data/Managed contains Assembly-CSharp.dll. The Linux launcher is only needed on native Linux.
